title: Consider an Imaginary Adoption Choice

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料；尚待独立教学与发音审核。

instructions: Write your own response. The example is for study and is not a submission.
prompt: Write 120–180 words to a fictional friend who is considering an animal companion. Describe their situation, two questions to ask staff and one hypothetical choice. Use at least six lesson words.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: 先说明朋友的时间和住处；再提出至少两个向工作人员核对的问题；最后用 if 和 would 或 could 写一个假设，不把示例当作真实领养建议。

reference: Dear Sam, you are thinking about an animal companion, but you have not made a decision. You work several evenings, so you could ask the rescue staff about a temporary foster stay before considering a permanent home. First, you could describe your schedule and ask what information the group needs. You could also ask about an adult animal's temperament and what a first visit involves. If you had more free time, you could make another visit before choosing. A gentle meeting could help you learn whether the arrangement is suitable, although one visit cannot show every detail. I know you like a friendly puppy with a soft blanket and a toy, but affection alone is not enough to decide. Trust takes patience, and honest questions are useful. Please follow the staff's current process rather than hurry.
referenceLabel: 原创示例，仅供学习；不要作为自己的待提交作文。
